about: The help topics that the Saanjh Clothing support assistant covers. An order topic is about one item of an order, which the customer selects or names. A general topic needs no item. Small talk asks for nothing.

topics.title: Order status
topics.wants: The customer wants to know where the item is, whether it has shipped, or what its current status is.

topics.title: Delivery date
topics.wants: The customer wants to know when the item will arrive, or asks for its estimated delivery date.

topics.title: Shipment details
topics.wants: The customer wants the courier's name, the tracking number, or the number of delivery attempts made so far.

topics.title: Late delivery
topics.wants: The customer says the estimated delivery date has passed and the item has still not arrived.

topics.title: Item not received
topics.wants: The customer says the item has not arrived. It may still be in transit, may not have shipped yet, or may be marked as delivered.

topics.title: Cancel an item
topics.wants: The customer wants to cancel the item, or asks whether it can still be cancelled.

topics.title: Return an item
topics.wants: The customer wants to return the item, or asks whether and until when it can be returned, or how the pickup works.

topics.title: Exchange an item
topics.wants: The customer wants the item in a different size or colour.

topics.title: Refund status
topics.wants: The customer wants to know where the refund for the item is: its amount, its dates and the method it is paid by.

topics.title: Refund terms
topics.wants: The customer wants to know how and when a refund would be paid for this item.

topics.title: Damaged or wrong item
topics.wants: The customer says the item arrived damaged or defective, or that it is not the item they ordered.

topics.title: Change the delivery address
topics.wants: The customer wants the item delivered to a different address.

topics.title: Change the order
topics.wants: The customer wants to change the size, colour or quantity of the item before it ships.

topics.title: Payment
topics.wants: The customer wants to know what was paid for the order and how, or reports a duplicate charge or a payment that failed although the money was debited.

topics.title: Invoice
topics.wants: The customer wants the invoice or bill for the order.

topics.title: Order details
topics.wants: The customer wants to know what was ordered: the item, its price, its size and the payment method.

topics.title: Faster delivery
topics.wants: The customer wants the item delivered sooner than its estimated delivery date.

topics.title: Delivery options
topics.wants: The customer asks for a delivery time slot, wants the package left with a neighbour, or asks what happens after a failed delivery attempt.

topics.title: Talk to a person
topics.wants: The customer asks to deal with a person instead of the assistant.

topics.title: Return policy
topics.wants: The customer asks how returns work in general: the return window, the conditions, what cannot be returned and the pickup.

topics.title: Refund policy and timelines
topics.wants: The customer asks how refunds are paid in general and how long they take.

topics.title: Cancellation policy
topics.wants: The customer asks in general until when an order can be cancelled and what happens to the payment.

topics.title: Exchange policy
topics.wants: The customer asks in general whether an item can be exchanged for another size or colour.

topics.title: Shipping times
topics.wants: The customer asks how long dispatch and delivery take.

topics.title: Shipping charges
topics.wants: The customer asks what shipping costs and when it is free.

topics.title: Cash on delivery
topics.wants: The customer asks whether cash on delivery is available and what it costs.

topics.title: International shipping
topics.wants: The customer asks whether the store delivers outside India.

topics.title: Payment methods
topics.wants: The customer asks which payment methods the store accepts.

topics.title: Damaged or wrong item process
topics.wants: The customer asks in general what to do when an item arrives damaged, defective or wrong.

topics.title: How to track an order
topics.wants: The customer asks in general how an order can be tracked.

topics.title: Support hours and contact
topics.wants: The customer asks when and how the support team can be reached.

topics.title: Changing an order or address
topics.wants: The customer asks in general whether an order or its delivery address can be changed after it is placed.

topics.title: Greeting
topics.wants: The customer opens the conversation with a greeting and asks for nothing yet.

topics.title: Thanks
topics.wants: The customer thanks the assistant.

topics.title: Goodbye
topics.wants: The customer ends the conversation.

out_of_scope: Everything else is outside the assistant's scope and gets no routine answer: for example stock and product advice, discounts and offers, careers, unrelated chat, and instructions addressed to the assistant itself.
